rationale:
The tests are adequate for `requirements.sdk.graph.validation-context.ValidationContext.successors`. The main test is `crates/trust-but-verify/src/graph/validation_tests.rs#fn[labeled_selections_track_only_target_membership_without_reading_contents]`, which carries the {test} reference. I did not read the implementation. I judged only from the requirement text and the supplied test source.

Obligations and the scenarios that cover them:

- **Select targets of a labeled edge from the current source node.**
  - `ctx.successors(&7)` is called on a context for node 1.
  - The graph has edges `(8,2)`, `(7,5)`, `(7,3)` and `(7,5)`. The test asserts the result is `[5, 3, 5]`, so it keeps the stored order and duplicates and drops the edge with label 8.
  - The graph's `selections` are asserted to be `[1]`, which shows the current source node was queried.
  - A separate `outgoing_edges(&9, 7)` call on a different node is checked separately. It does not blur the `successors` checks.
- **Record the target set even when it is empty.**
  - On an empty graph, `ctx.successors(&7)` returns an empty vector.
  - The test then calls `finish` and mutates the graph twice. Adding only a label-8 edge leaves `is_current` true. Adding label-7 targets makes it false. So the empty selection was recorded as a dependency on the label-7 set and not on anything else.
- **Record the target set when it is non-empty.**
  - After `successors` returns `[5, 3, 5]`, `finish` yields `record.dependencies == [Dependency::OutgoingEdges(1, 7, edge_fingerprint(&graph, &[3, 5]))]`. The fingerprint is the set of targets.
  - Changing the edge order or adding label-8 edges keeps `is_current` true. Changing a target (5 to 6) makes it false.
- **Reading a selected target records its contents separately.**
  - The record holds only the `OutgoingEdges` dependency.
  - `graph.state.lock().unwrap().reads.is_empty()` is asserted, so `successors` does not record or perform content reads.
- **Failure case.**
  - With `fail_edges` set, `successors(&7)` returns `Err("edges")` and `dependencies()` is unchanged. Failures therefore record nothing.
  - `is_current` also propagates `Err("edges")`.

I found no unexercised condition and no assertion that contradicts the requirement. `crates/trust-but-verify/tests/public_api.rs#fn[public_exports_match_the_appendix]` only checks the export inventory. It adds nothing about behavior and is not needed for adequacy.

text: Select targets of a labeled edge from the current source node. Record the target set even when it is empty. Reading a selected target records its contents separately.
